# Tabler

Vendored `@tabler/core` v1.4.0 CSS, distributed under MIT. The complete license is in `LICENSE`.

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@tabler/core@1.4.0/dist/css/tabler.min.css
Upstream: https://github.com/tabler/tabler/tree/v1.4.0

Loaded before existing toolkit styles. `src/ui/workspace.css` adapts the framework to existing engineering tool templates. No Tabler JavaScript or external fonts are required. The source-map reference is removed because the source map is not shipped.
